newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium falls with dlr on stop-loss sales.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium falls with dlr on stop-loss sales.

text.p: Tokyo aluminium futures closed sharply lower on Thursday, hit by stop-loss selling triggered by the dollar's dive to its lowest level against the yen since January, traders said.
"We saw stop-loss selling in the afternoon," said a trader at a major trading house. "Future movements hinge on the currency market," he said.
Traders said individual investors, who were buyers at the opening, placed sell orders when they saw the dollar diving to below 116 yen.
TOCOM yen-based aluminium futures ranged between 2.5 yen to 5.6 yen per kg lower, with benchmark April 1998 shedding 4.4 yen to close at 196.2 yen.
Estimated trade volume was 5,003 lots, up from 2,578 lots, down on Wednesday. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-6179
